extensionDescription.message: Make X (formerly Twitter) easier to use. Save images, like posts, bookmark posts, and more using customizable keyboard shortcuts.

saveImageDescription.message: Save images from the hovered post

shortcutTooltip.message: Click, then press the key you want to assign. Press Esc to cancel.

shortcutDuplicateError.message: This key is already assigned. Please choose another key.

likeDescription.message: Like or unlike the hovered post

retweetNote.message: Opens a menu to repost or undo a repost

mediaDefaultDescription.message: Open the Media tab with photos selected by default

privateAccountFilterDescription.message: Blur posts from protected accounts (click to reveal)

accountSwitcherDescription.message: Press Shift + Space to open the account switcher

hideOtherAccountNotificationsDescription.message: Hide notifications for other accounts in the account menu

mediaFilterDescription.message: Press Shift + M to show only posts containing media

feedbackDescription.message: Bug reports, feature requests, and feedback are welcome.
